'''The galaxy''', as it was commonly referred to, was one of trillions of [[Galaxy|galaxies]] in the [[Universe|observable universe]]. The galaxy was a vast composite of over 400 billion estimated [[star]]s and over 3.2 billion habitable [[Star system|systems]] orbiting around a supermassive [[black hole]] known as the [[Galactic Centre]], which existed at the [[heart]] of the galaxy. The four galactic arms rotated around this black hole across a diameter of around 120,000 [[light-year]]s. It was home to countless [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] and star systems.

The galaxy would serve as the setting for society, trade, [[politics]], and war throughout [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]]. In historical memory, the galaxy would see the successive eras of the [[Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire]], [[New Republic]], among others, and was home to the [[Force-sensitive]] sects such as the [[Jedi Order]] and [[Sith]] and numerous cultural groups such as the [[Mandalorian]]s.

==Astrography==
===Overview===
{{Quote|...be transported from the Outer Rim to as far away as the Core Worlds. However there are several other regions within our galaxy. They are the Mid Rim...The Expansion Region, the Inner Rim, the Colonies, Core, and Deep Core.|A [[Unidentified protocol droid teacher|protocol droid teacher]] to her students|<ref name="Chapter 12">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 12: The Siege}}</ref>}}
[[File:GalaxyMap_JediArchives.png|thumb|left|250px|The galaxy had two satellite galaxies]]
The [[galaxy]] had a diameter of 120,000 [[light-year]]s,<ref name="Altaya" /> over 400 billion [[star]]s, more than 3.2 billion habitable [[star system]]s,<ref name="VE" /> and was near at least two companion galaxies,<ref name="Episode II" /> one of which was the [[Rishi Maze]], an irregular<ref name="CL 2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> dwarf satellite [[galaxy]]<ref name="AB Update">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> in decaying orbit around the galaxy.<ref name="CL 2016" /> Outside its borders, the galaxy was surrounded by the [[intergalactic void]].<ref name="Part 4">{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}}</ref> Within its space, the galaxy was divided into several regions. The regions were subdivided into [[sector]]s and then star systems which contained [[planet]]s. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], [[oversector]]s were created and were composed of several sectors ruled by a [[Grand Moff]].<ref name="Tarkin" /> Notable sectors/autonomous regions included the [[Arkanis sector]], [[Bothan Space]], [[Centrality]], [[Corporate Sector]], [[Gordian Reach]], [[Greater Javin]], [[Hapes Consortium]], [[Hutt Space]], [[Mandalore sector|Mandalorian Space]], [[Moddell sector]], [[Senex-Juvex]], [[Tion Cluster]],<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> and [[Western Reaches]].<ref name="Star Map" />

The [[Standard Galactic Grid]] was used to give the location of a galactic point in grid coordinates.<ref name="Rebel Dossier">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]''</ref> Areas of the galactic disk could be referred to as the galactic north, south, east and west.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi">''[[Heir to the Jedi]]''</ref> Notable points of interest were the fifty wonders of the [[Core Worlds]], thirty wonders of the [[Mid Rim Territories]] and the twenty-five wonders of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Catalyst" /> There were millions of [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] in the galaxy.<ref name="TSWB" /> Millions of billions of individual beings called the galaxy home.<ref name="Through the Turbulence">{{StoryCite|story=Through the Turbulence|book=Stories of Jedi and Sith}}</ref>

===Deep Core===
{{Main|Deep Core}}
{{Quote|It's crowded in there and things move fast.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Heir to the Jedi" />}}
The [[Deep Core]] served as the innermost and most brightly lit region of [[Realspace|space]]. It was densely-packed with stars, [[nebula]]e, and other anomalies. As such, it was dangerous to navigate, leaving it relatively few explorers.<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> It was from here that the ancient, super-massive [[black hole]]<ref name="Twilight Company" /> known as the [[Galactic Centre]]<ref name="Falcon 36">{{BuildFalconCite|36|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> bound the galaxy together.<ref name="Twilight Company" />

===Core Worlds===
{{Main|Core Worlds}}
{{Quote|The Clone Wars did the unthinkable—it put the Core Worlds at risk. The insulated heart of the Republic had grown complacent in a sense of security and comfort. By war's end, the encroaching fear of Separatist attack reshaped the galaxy.|Janyor|<ref name="Propaganda">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Coruscant_system-TPM.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Core World Coruscant was the historic center of galactic power.]]
The Core Worlds were home to the richest and most important worlds in the galaxy. Densely inhabited and located on the strategic ends of several major [[Hyperspace route|trade lanes]], its planets were hubs of fashion, education, finance, and technology. It is where the [[human]] [[species]] arguably<ref name="VE" /> began.<ref name="Uprising">''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]''</ref> It was from [[Coruscant]], [[Corellia]], [[Kuat]], [[Hosnian Prime]], and other systems that the fate of the galaxy was often decided.<ref name="SWGA" />

An attack on the Core Worlds was virtually inconceivable during the [[Republic Era]]; according to the [[Bith]] [[artist]] [[Janyor]], the "sense of security and comfort" created an atmosphere of complacency within the heartland of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Toward the end of the [[Clone Wars]] though Core Worlders became increasingly fearful of a direct attack by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Propaganda" />

===Colonies===
{{Main|Colonies}}
The [[Colonies]] consisted of worlds colonized by the Core. Many of its planets sat along major trade routes, and were extremely wealthy. Notable planets included [[Abednedo (planet)|Abednedo]],<ref name="SWGA" /> [[Cato Neimoidia]], and [[Carida]].<ref name="TFABG" />

===Inner Rim Territories===
{{Main|Inner Rim Territories}}
When first settled, the [[Inner Rim Territories]] served as the frontier of galactic civilization for [[Standard century|centuries]], known simply as "the Rim." As colonization spread outwards, Inner Rim worlds prospered. Notable planets included [[Bestine IV|Bestine]], [[Onderon]], [[Thyferra]], and [[Taanab]].<ref name="TFABG" />

===Expansion Region===
{{Main|Expansion Region}}
The [[Expansion Region]] contained many newer colonies sponsored by their coreward neighbors. Notable planets included [[Umbara]], [[Mimban]],<ref name="SWGA" /><ref name="TFABG" /> and the [[mining]] station known as the [[Ring of Kafrene]].<ref name="RO World Locations">{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-rogue-one|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Rogue One''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Rogue One?}}</ref>

===Mid Rim Territories===
{{Main|Mid Rim Territories}}
[[File:TheedPalace_night.png|thumb|left|250px|The planet Naboo was located in the Mid Rim Territories.]]
The Mid Rim Territories were a tranquil region of space that brimmed with varied galactic worlds that boasted successful governments and thriving economies. Distance from the Core gave these worlds less fame or notoriety than planets closer to the galactic center.<ref name="SWGA" /> The Mid Rim was unofficially considered the lawful extent of the Galactic Republic and Galactic Empire.<ref name="Twilight Company" /><ref name="VE" /> Spillover [[Pirate|piracy]] from the Outer Rim affected the region.<ref name="SWGA" /> Those headed towards the Outer Rim saw it as the last taste of civilization, while those heading corewards saw it as the last grasp of frontier living.<ref name="TFA VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Notable planets included [[Naboo]], [[Malastare]], [[Bothawui]], [[Kashyyyk]], [[Ruusan]], [[Ringo Vinda]], and [[Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TFABG" />

===Outer Rim Territories===
{{Main|Outer Rim Territories}}
{{Quote|The Outer Rim is a lawless place.|[[Jennica Pierce]]|<ref name="Allies">{{FFGTCG|set=Allies of Necessity|parent=2}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mos_Eisley.png|thumb|right|250px|The Outer Rim was home to worlds such as the desert planet of Tatooine.]]
The largest<ref name="SWGA" /> region of the known galaxy, the Outer Rim Territories were considered to be lawless, strange, and savage. Criminal organizations, including the [[Hutt Clan]] of [[Hutt Space]], the [[Black Sun]], [[Pyke Syndicate]], and [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s operated in abundance within the region.<ref name="VE" /> Notable worlds included [[Arkanis]], [[Mon Cala]], [[Kessel]], [[Ryloth]], [[Eriadu]], [[Sullust]], [[Geonosis]], [[Mustafar]], [[Crait]], [[Nal Hutta]], [[Cantonica]], [[Hoth]], [[Lothal]], [[Dagobah]], [[Endor]], [[Nar Shaddaa]], [[Florrum]], [[Yavin 4]], [[Saleucami]], [[Scarif]], [[Felucia]], [[Dathomir]], and [[Tatooine]].<ref name="TFABG" />

===Unknown Regions===
{{Main|Unknown Regions}}
{{Quote|The Unknown Regions are vast.|[[Caluan Ematt]]|<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Unknown_Regions_TROS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mysterious and largely unexplored, the Unknown Regions was located beyond the known galaxy.]]
The [[Unknown Regions]] was composed of the westward arm of the galaxy that was mapped, but largely unexplored.<ref name="SWGA" /> Solar storms, rogue magnetospheres, black holes, [[gravity well]]s, and other handicaps to [[hyperspace]] travel left it largely unexplored throughout galactic history.<ref name="Empire's End">''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]''</ref> Mysterious species shrouded in myth, such the [[Chiss]]<ref name="Thrawn">[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']]</ref> and [[Grysk]],<ref name="Thrawn: Alliances">''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]''</ref> as well as the deeply-religious [[Kilji]] species originated from the Unknown Regions. Notable planets included [[Csilla]],<ref name="TFABG" /> [[Ilum]],<ref name="Ultimate">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> [[Rakata Prime]],<ref name="TFA VD" /> [[Exegol]],<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and [[Ahch-To]].<ref name="TLJ VD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

===Wild Space===
{{Main|Wild Space}}
{{Quote|Those systems are beyond the Outer Rim, in Wild Space. Not on any map.|Kanan Jarrus|<ref name="Lasat">{{Rebels|Legends of the Lasat}}</ref>}}
Unlike other regions of the galaxy, [[Wild Space]] existed along the entire circumference of the galactic disk and on the borderlands of the Unknown Regions.<ref name="TFABG" /> It was inhabited by [[Sentience|sentient]] species but not fully charted, explored, and civilized.<ref name="Tarkin" /><ref name="Star Map" /> Explorers and [[cartographer]]s sought their fortune here at their peril.<ref name="SWGA" />

==History==
===Early galactic civilization===
{{Main|Timeline of galactic history}}
{{Quote|Societal memories and official calendars started fresh, and the time before this rebirth was forgotten as a dark age, lumped into a collective whole known as the 'Old Republic.'|Janyor|<ref name="Propaganda" />}}
[[File:OldRepublicEmblem.svg|thumb|right|200px|The Old Republic was an early incarnation of the Galactic Republic.]]
The [[Timeline of galactic history|history of the galaxy]] spans many [[Millennium|millennia]]. Approximately twenty-five millennia before the [[Battle of Yavin]], one or more ancestor species discovered hyperspace travel. This invention opened the galaxy up for exploration and travel.<ref name="Tarkin" />

To navigate the unimaginably large distances between star systems, spacecraft utilized a [[hyperdrive]]. This [[Engine|propulsion system]] allowed travel through hyperspace, an alternate dimension where a [[starship]] could take advantage of the wrinkles in the fabric of [[Space-time continuum|spacetime]] to reduce journey [[time]] and distance significantly, effectively "jumping" from point to point without having to travel directly between them.<ref name="LOTJ">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref> Galactic travelers used [[hyperspace sextant]]s for navigating hyperspace roughly four thousand years before the [[Cold War]].<ref name="TFA VD" />

In ancient times, beings from a [[far galaxy]] built a [[Seatos reflex point|reflex point]] on the planet [[Seatos]] which [[Pathway to Peridea|pointed the way]] to an extragalactic location known to [[Peridea]]. While some such as former [[Jedi Knight]] [[Baylan Skoll]] regarded Peridea as a fairytale, [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] survivor Lady [[Morgan Elsbeth]] regarded Peridea as a real place that was the ancient homeworld of her ancestors.<ref name="Ahsoka 2">{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}}</ref> A [[Arcana Star Map|star map]] pointing the way to the far galaxy was also stored inside a [[Nightsisters' Temple|Nightsister stronghold]] on [[Arcana]].<ref name="Ahsoka 1">{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}}</ref>

The [[Old Republic-era]]<ref name="Official Guide">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> began with the formation of the early Republic<ref name="TSWB" /><ref name="Old Galactic Republic">''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising]]'' states that the [[Galactic Republic]] fought against the [[Sith Empire]]. As the Empire was destroyed by the [[time]] of the modern Republic's founding per ''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'', and the Republic that existed prior to the [[Sith]]'s fall is referred to as the Old Republic by ''Star Wars Propaganda'', it can be found that the Old Republic was the Galactic Republic, only that the government of the time before the Sith's fall came to be commonly known as the Old Republic.</ref> around [[25,000 BBY]].<ref name="25,000 BBY Date Note">''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' places the founding of the [[Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] to around 25,000 [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[25,000 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Therefore, they must have been founded around 25,000 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> The Republic was founded by the [[Core Founder]]s, a group of twenty-two Core Worlds which included the planet [[Alderaan]].<ref name="Rising Storm">''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]''</ref>

[[File:Prime_Jedi.png|thumb|left|220px|The Jedi Order was founded by the Prime Jedi thousands of years before the Battle of Yavin.]]
The [[Jedi Order]] was also formed around 25,000 BBY.<ref name="25,000 BBY Date Note" /> A noble group of [[Force-sensitive]]s capable of harnessing the [[Force power|powers]] of [[the Force]],<ref name="Jedi Order DB">{{Databank|jedi-order|Jedi Order}}</ref> the Order originated with the [[Prime Jedi]] on the planet Ahch-To, where the [[first Jedi Temple]] was built.<ref name="TLJ VD" /> As told by [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], "the [[Jedi]] served as the guardians of peace and justice for over a thousand generations in the Old Republic."<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Later, a sect of Force-sensitives who followed the [[dark side of the Force]] split from the Jedi<ref name="Tarkin" /> to form the [[Sith]] during the [[Hundred-Year Darkness]].<ref name="Star Wars 9">[[Star Wars (2015) 9|''Star Wars'' (2015) 9]]</ref> In one of their wars, the world [[Malachor]] was devastated during the [[Great Scourge of Malachor]], which left the battlefield littered with the petrified corpses of the Sith and Jedi combatants.<ref name="Twilight of the Apprentice">{{Rebels|Twilight of the Apprentice}}</ref>

The Sith built an [[Sith Empire|Empire]] through the use of [[Slavery|slave labor]].<ref name="EfK">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref><ref name="Empire's End" /> During their period of galactic dominance, the Sith built a [[Shrine in the Depths|shrine]] on Coruscant. The [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] was constructed over the foundations of the shrine subsequent to the [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith war)|Jedi victory]] that drove the Sith from Coruscant.<ref name="Tarkin" />

[[File:BaneSidiousVader.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Sith Order survived for generations under Darth Bane's Rule of Two.]]
The [[Jedi-Sith War|last conflict]] between the Jedi Knights<ref name="Bane Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Darth Bane|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11644161/2018-Topps-Star-Wars-Galactic-Files-ACW-29-Darth-Bane}}</ref> and the Sith ended with the [[defeat of the Sith]]<ref name="Tarkin" /> on the Mid Rim planet<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Ruusan]]<ref name="HC 29">{{HelmetCollectionCite|29|Databank A-Z}}</ref> in [[1032 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> The victory of the Republic was so complete<ref name="Propaganda" /> that the Jedi believed the Sith to be extinct. However, the Sith lineage continued through a sole survivor, Sith [[Lord]] [[Darth Bane]] whose [[Rule of Two]] ensured the continuation of the Sith<ref name="Sacrifice">{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}}</ref> for a millennium in [[Grand Plan|secret]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> Bane's [[death]] by the hand of his [[Sith apprentice]]<ref name="SOTS" /> [[Darth Zannah]]<ref name="HC 2">{{HelmetCollectionCite|2|Databank A-Z}}</ref> began a tradition in which the apprentice finished their training by killing their [[Sith Master|Master]].<ref name="SOTS" />

In addition to the Sith,<ref name="Propaganda" /> the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]]<ref name="DBZygerrian">{{Databank|zygerrian|Zygerrian}}</ref> and the [[Mandalorian]]s were adversaries of the Jedi Order.<ref name="Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> The Jedi [[Jedi–Zygerrian conflict|defeated]] the [[Zygerrian]]s,<ref name="DBZygerrian" /> but lost to the Mandalorians with the [[sacking of the Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Mandalore Plot" /> In the sack, the Jedi Order lost one of their [[Jedi artifact|artifacts]], the [[Darksaber]]. Forged by [[Tarre Vizsla]], the first Mandalorian ever inducted into the Jedi Order,<ref name="Trials of the Darksaber">{{Rebels|Trials of the Darksaber}}</ref> the Darksaber was taken from the [[Jedi temple|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant by members of [[House Vizsla]].<ref name="Mandalore Plot" /> The Jedi eventually won the [[Mandalorian-Jedi War]],<ref name="Trials of the Darksaber" /> a conflict that left the planet [[Mandalore]] [[Annihilation|devastated]] and transformed into a largely uninhabitable wasteland.<ref name="Mandalorian super commando">{{SWE|groups|mandalorian-super-commando|Mandalorian super commando}}</ref>

===The Galactic Republic===
{{Main|Republic Era}}
====Forming a new era====
{{Quote|The Republic victory was so definitive that it reinvented itself, resettling its capital on Coruscant after a devastating ouster. History reset its chrono on this date, and from that moment, the modern Galactic Republic was born.|Janyor|<ref name="Propaganda" />}}
[[File:CoruscantBG-SWcom.png|thumb|left|250px|Under the protection of the Jedi Order, the modern Galactic Republic presided over a millennium of peace.]]
The defeat of the Sith brought about the formation of the modern Republic<ref name="Propaganda" /> in 1032 BBY.<ref name="Galactic Republic Date Note">''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' dates the restoration of the Republic to 1,032 [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[1032 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Therefore, the restoration must have occurred in 1032 BBY.</ref> This version of the Republic, while viewed as the "latest evolution" of a millennia-old [[Democracy|democratic]] [[Politics|polity]], was nevertheless a new beginning for galactic society. Its establishment therefore served as the epoch of the new era, while the history prior to the reinvention of the Republic was ultimately lost and referred to as the "Old Republic."<ref name="Propaganda" />

As the home of the [[Galactic Senate]], Coruscant served as the political [[capital]] of the galaxy.<ref name="Propaganda" /> The Republic was the dominant galactic government for a thousand years until the [[Separatist Crisis]] and the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars.<ref name="Episode II" /> During the Republic's reign, the Core Worlds underwent a wave of expansion by settling new worlds and establishing trading colonies. In the process, they also cut deals with native populations or simply overran them.<ref name="Tarkin" /> A millennium before [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Yavin Code Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of "[[The Big Bang]]" to [[19 BBY]]. In the episode, it is stated that the Yavin Code is about a [[Millennium|thousand years]] old. Therefore, the Code must have been established about a millennium prior to 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> the [[Yavin Code]] was established during the [[Yavin Convention]] to govern the treatment of [[prisoner]]s.<ref name="The Big Bang">{{TCW|The Big Bang}}</ref>

====High Republic Era====
{{Main|High Republic Era}}
When the [[Evereni]] left their [[homeworld]] of [[Everon]], they were surprised to find other life-forms and, due to their natural inclination to distrust others, began to wipe out the beings they encountered, turning themselves into outlaws and forcing them to act through more covert means.<ref name="EotS1">[[The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 1|''The High Republic: Eye of the Storm'' 1]]</ref> During the [[High Republic Era]], the galaxy was believed to be at peace, resulting in less of a need for military forces. Protected by the Jedi and the [[Republic Defense Coalition]], the Republic expanded into the Outer Rim to spread its era of ambition and [[Great Works]], yet it would instead find itself in [[Nihil conflict|conflict]] with the [[Nihil]] after the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]]<ref name="Light of the Jedi">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref> in [[232 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> In truth, the Nihil were pawns of a [[Ro family|family of Evereni]] who wanted revenge on the Jedi and Republic for past events<ref name="EotS1" /> that stretched back to the days of the [[Path of the Open Hand]] cult:<ref name="Path Ven">''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]''</ref> over a century prior,<ref name="Timelines" /> the Path had entered into conflict with the Jedi due to their opposing views on the Force, which the Path believed no living being was allowed to manipulate. To secure an advantage over the Jedi, [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Elecia Zeveron]] unleashed beings known as the Nameless, which hunted Force-sensitives and were controlled by a [[Nameless control rods|set of rods]].<ref name="Path Ven">''[[The High Republic: Path of Vengeance]]''</ref>

First unleashing a [[Shrikarai|Nameless]]<ref name="Path Ven" /> known later as the [[Great Leveler]],<ref name="Rising Storm">''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]''</ref> the Path journeyed to the [[Sophros|Nameless homeworld]] after stirring the [[Battle of Jedha]] into being. On the world, informally known as Planet X, the Path discovered more Nameless eggs, but one team member, [[Bokana Koss]], experienced a Force vision that warned him beings known as the [[Under-Dweller]]s would take advantage of their mission to spread across the galaxy as a [[blight]], with that blight "chaining" and trying to destroy the Force itself if unleashed. Ignoring his warning, the Path made it off Planet X despite the efforts of a being known as the [[Protector (Planet X)|protector]] and [[The Veil (Planet X)|the Veil]]. In the ensuing [[Night of Sorrow]], the Path, reformed into the [[Path of the Closed Fist]], warred with the Jedi and their allies until [[Guide of the Closed Fist|Path Guide]] [[Marda Ro]]—who was horrified at the way the Nameless feasted upon people, witnessed that the Nameless targeted members of her own order without regard if they happened to be Force-sensitive, and realized the Mother had lied to her—wiped out the Nameless with the exception of the Leveler. After killing Zeveron with the Leveler and escaping with the beast,<ref name="Path Ven" /> Ro forged the original incarnation of the Nihil<ref name="Temptation">''[[The High Republic: Temptation of the Force]]''</ref> and passed her revenge down over the generations<ref name="EotS1" /> with the hope they would at last "free" the Force."<ref name="Path Ven" />

Those efforts culminated in the finalized Nihil and<ref name="EotS1" /> Marda's descendant<ref name="Temptation" /> [[Marchion Ro]],<ref name="EotS1" /> who claimed to still practice the family rituals<ref name="Rising Storm" /> and was dedicated to their revenge,<ref name="Light of the Jedi" /> but, perhaps without realizing it, was most interesting in securing his own freedom from anyone who would chain him down.<ref name="EotS2">[[The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 2|''The High Republic: Eye of the Storm'' 2]]</ref> Marchion led the Nihil through war with the Republic and Jedi and rediscovered the Great Leveler,<ref name="Rising Storm" /> in time [[Mission to Planet X|venturing to Planet X]] himself with the Nihil to claim even more Nameless. Thanks to Ro, the Nihil [[Destruction of Starlight Beacon|brought down]] Supreme Chancellor [[Lina Soh]]'s great [[Starlight Beacon]] project and [[Deployment of the stormseeds|claimed]] an entire segment of the galaxy as [[Occlusion Zone|Nihil-controlled space]].<ref name="EotS2" /> As the Jedi and Republic continued their conflict against the Nihil and worked to free the sectors the pirates had claimed,<ref name="Temptation" /> however, the blight foretold by Koss<ref name="Path Ven" /> was discovered by both the Jedi and Nihil.<ref name="Temptation" />

====Late Republic Era====
{{Quote|The galaxy is filled with wonders, my friend. Some amazing, others abominable.|[[Mace Windu]] to [[Pintu]]|<ref name="ShadowsComeKran">{{InsiderCite|212|Galactic Tales: From The Shadows Come The Kran}}</ref>}}
As the Republic continued along, corruption began to take greater power in the Galactic Senate, while [[megacorporation]]s like the [[Trade Federation]] were granted representation within the government body.<ref name="Episode I" /> The Jedi Order grew to be unwilling to challenge the corruption of the Senate at large<ref name="TOTJ Choices">{{TOTJ|Choices}}</ref> and increasingly isolated from the greater galaxy<ref name="The Living Force">''[[The Living Force]]''</ref> even though discontent with the Republic and its corruption emerged.<ref name="TOTJ Choices" /><ref name="Justice">{{TOTJ|Justice (episode)}}</ref>

[[File:Sidious_hologram.png|thumb|right|250px|The Sith Lord Darth Sidious masterminded his own rise to power as Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine.]]
In the years leading up to the Clone Wars, [[Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas]] foresaw an upcoming conflict and, against the wishes of the Jedi Order, commissioned the [[Kaminoan]]s to create an [[army]] of [[clone trooper]]s on [[Kamino]].<ref name="Episode II" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> a dispute between the Republic and the [[Trade Federation]] over the [[Prop 31-814D|taxation]] of [[Free Trade Zone|trade routes]] to outlying systems led the Federation to impose a [[Invasion of Naboo|blockade]] on the Mid Rim world of Naboo. The Federation was eventually expelled by a coalition of [[Naboo (people)|Naboo humans]], [[Gungan]]s, and Jedi. [[Senator]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] of Naboo took advantage of the occupation of his [[homeworld]] in order to succeed [[Finis Valorum]] as [[Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Episode I" /> In secret, Palpatine was [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Sidious, who was dedicated to reestablishing the Sith’s rule of the galaxy.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
{{Main|Clone Wars}}
{{Quote|For years, the Clone Wars raged across hundreds of worlds. The Jedi led their seemingly faithful clone troops in an onslaught of harrowing battles, their Order growing ever weaker.|Darth Sidious|<ref name="SOTS">''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Battle_of_Geonosis.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist Crisis led to open war between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.]]
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was formed between [[24 BBY]] and [[22 BBY]]<ref name="CIS Formation Date Note">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' establishes that the [[Raxus Address]] and following foundation of the Confederacy of Independent Systems occurred two [[Standard year|years]] before the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], which, along with the other events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[22 BBY]]. Therefore, simple math can be used to find the CIS was formed in [[24 BBY]]. Additionally, because the ratification of the [[Geonosian accord]] first appeared in ''Attack of the Clones'', the events of which are dated to 22 BBY by ''Galactic Atlas'', the accord must have been ratified in 22 BBY.</ref> as a result of widespread dissatisfaction with the Republic. The Separatist movement was led by [[Count]] [[Dooku]], a former Jedi Master who became Darth Sidious' second Sith apprentice as Darth Tyranus. During the [[Separatist Crisis]], several thousand star systems and corporations declared their intention to leave the Republic. The discovery of a clone army on Kamino and the [[Separatist Droid Army]] on Geonosis set the stage for the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], which became the catalyst of the Clone Wars. At the urging of [[Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks]], the Senate transferred [[Emergency Powers Act|emergency powers]] to Chancellor Palpatine, who used his new-found powers to formally create the [[Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Episode II" />

[[File:Battle_of_Christophsis.png|thumb|right|250px|During the Clone Wars, Republic and Separatist armies fought numerous battles across the galaxy.]]
The Clone Wars engulfed much of the galaxy for the next three years.<ref name="SWGA" /> The Jedi-led [[Republic Military]] and [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] fought on multiple worlds and fronts including [[Christophsis]],<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> Ryloth,<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> Umbara,<ref name="Darkness on Umbara">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref> Onderon,<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> Coruscant, [[Utapau]], and Kashyyyk. The Confederacy of Independent Systems collapsed with the [[death]]s of Dooku, [[General]] [[Grievous]], and the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] [[Mission to Mustafar|on Mustafar]]. Chancellor Palpatine, having accused the Jedi Order of [[treason]], commanded the Grand Army of the Republic to execute [[Order 66]], resulting in many Jedi being gunned down by their clone troopers. With the Jedi Order effectively destroyed, Palpatine was [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclaimed]] as [[Galactic Emperor]] and the Republic was reorganized into the first [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Episode III" />

[[File:AmeddaJediEradicationCeremony-2017DarthVader1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|With the Jedi all but destroyed, the Republic was supplanted by the first Galactic Empire.]]
Most of the Jedi were killed in the [[Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> Whereas the Order comprised ten thousand Jedi Knights at the time of the Clone Wars, only a few survivors remained during the height of Imperial rule.<ref name="The Siege of Lothal">''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal]]''</ref> The Jedi were vilified by Imperial [[propaganda]], with [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]] publicly denouncing them while hosting a [[Celebration marking the eradication of the Jedi Order|celebration]] of their eradication at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.<ref name="Dark Lord 1">[[Darth Vader (2017) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 1]]</ref> The Jedi who survived the initial purge were scattered across the galaxy. Master Kenobi fled to Tatooine,<ref name="Episode IV" /> Grand Master [[Yoda]] retreated to Dagobah, a wild and swampy world;<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref> and Padawan [[Cal Kestis]] joined the [[Scrapper Guild]] on [[Bracca]].<ref name="JFO">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>

A number of Jedi even joined the Empire. The [[Inquisitorius]], a group of [[Jedi hunter]]s who served the Empire, was composed of fallen Jedi such as the [[Second Sister]], who was once Trilla Suduri of the Jedi Order.<ref name="JFO" /> Kenobi’s former apprentice Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker]] became Sidious' final apprentice;<ref name="Episode III" /> as Darth Vader and was instrumental in the Great Jedi Purge.<ref name="Episode IV" />

===The Galactic Empire===
{{Main|Imperial Era}}
{{Quote|Under the Sith… [the galaxy] is a ''pyramid''. Everyone climbing to the same place, pushing others down so they can ascend. And at its peak, someone waits ready to ''destroy'' anyone who would dare approach. The only ''truly free'' person in the entire galaxy. ''Emperor Palpatine''. His name, his ''Sith'' name, is ''Darth Sidious''. The name of his apprentice is ''Darth Vader''. They are the two ''most powerful'' people in the galaxy.|[[Qi'ra]]|<ref name="Crimson 1">[[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:Moff_Tarkin.png|thumb|right|250px|As Emperor Palpatine, Darth Sidious ruled the galaxy with Darth Vader as his apprentice and enforcer.]]
The [[Fascism|fascist]] Galactic Empire became the dominant government of the galaxy for the next two and a half [[Standard decade|decades]]. The Empire assumed control over galactic society, interplanetary economies, the [[HoloNet]], and a sprawling [[Imperial Military]].<ref name="Propaganda" /> As Galactic Emperor, Palpatine wielded considerable power over the Empire's military, resources, and inhabitants. The revamped [[Imperial Senate]] saw more of its powers being transferred to planetary and regional [[governor]]s who had been appointed by the Empire.<ref name="Rebels Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>

The [[Imperial Survey Corps]] took an interest in exploring the uncharted reaches of space, including the Unknown Regions<ref name="Tarkin" /> and Wild Space. As a result, the demand for maps and cartographers exponentially increased. This allowed explorers such as [[Auric Graf|Auric]] and [[Rhyssa Graf]] to make a decent living from selling maps until they were kidnapped by the Imperial [[Captain]] [[Visler Aqorian Korda III]].<ref name="Escape">''[[Adventures in Wild Space: The Escape]]''</ref> In addition, the Empire created a galactic-wide network of [[Imperial Academy|Imperial Academies]] to indoctrinate and train youths to serve in the Imperial Military.<ref name="Edge of the Galaxy">''[[Servants of the Empire: Edge of the Galaxy]]''</ref> In secret, the Empire embarked on an ambitious [[Project Stardust|program]] to create a planet-destroying [[superweapon]] called the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]].<ref name="Tarkin" />

[[File:StrengthAndObedience-SWPropaganda.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The New Order was maintained through Imperial propaganda and military might.]]
The Empire also expropriated land and resources and ruthlessly stamped out dissent. HoloNet and other media became a [[propaganda]] medium for the Empire.<ref name="Edge of the Galaxy" /> In addition, the Empire was [[Xenophobia|xenophobic]] and favored humans at the expense of [[alien]] species. In the Imperial order, aliens were regarded as serfs, slaves, and obstacles needing to be tamed, removed, or ignored. Humans came to dominate the Imperial government and military while alien species, such as the [[Wookiee]]s and the [[Talz]] were enslaved.<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> Other alien species such as the [[Lasat]]<ref name="Droids in Distress">{{Rebels|Droids in Distress}}</ref> to make an example and the [[Geonosian]]s also [[Siege of Lasan|experienced]] [[Sterilization of Geonosis|genocide]] to keep the Death Star secret.<ref name="Ghosts of Genosis">{{Rebels|Ghosts of Geonosis}}</ref> Despite this entrenched xenophobia, some aliens rose to positions of prominence in the Empire such as the [[Chagrian]] [[Grand Vizier]] [[Mas Amedda]],<ref name="Tarkin" /> the [[Pau'an]] [[The Grand Inquisitor|Grand Inquisitor]],<ref name="Rise of the Old Masters">{{Rebels|Rise of the Old Masters}}</ref> and the Chiss [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]].<ref name="Steps Into Shadow">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]''</ref>

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] set a new galactic record by making the [[Kessel Run]] in less than twelve parsecs aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', which he later acquired from [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. Solo and his companions his partner [[Chewbacca]], his lover [[Lady]] [[Qi'ra]], his mentor [[Tobias Beckett]], Calrissian, and [[L3-37]] had earlier [[Raid on Kessel|stolen]] [[coaxium]] from the spice mining world of [[Kessel]] in order to settle Beckett's debts to the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate. Solo and his companions were later [[Showdown on Savareen|involved]] in the death of Crimson Dawn public leader [[Dryden Vos]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

===The Galactic Civil War===
{{Main|Galactic Civil War}}
{{Quote|The Galactic Civil War was not a battle for territory. It was a struggle for the hearts and minds of the galaxy.|Janyor|<ref name="Propaganda" />}}
[[File:Scarif_Battle_GaG_cover_art.png|thumb|right|250px|The Galactic Civil War was a conflict between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic.]]
As the Empire tightened its grip on the galaxy, [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|resistance movements]] sprang up on a number of worlds. Most of these movements were strictly local, determined to free an individual planet or star system from Imperial rule.<ref name="Rebel DB">{{Databank|rebel-alliance|Rebel Alliance}}</ref> Eventually, however, dissatisfaction and opposition to the Empire culminated in a scattered network of [[Rebel cell (disambiguation)|rebel cell]]s. In [[4 BBY]],<ref name="FAtG Date">{{RebelsDate|115}}</ref> rebel cells [[Action at Mustafar|began]] to coalesce into larger groups such as the [[Phoenix Cell]], ending a previous policy of maintaining secrecy<ref name="Fire Across the Galaxy">{{Rebels|Fire Across the Galaxy}}</ref> and beginning the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GCW Date">The {{SW|url=mustafar-history-gallery|text=Mustafar History Gallery}} states that the [[action at Mustafar]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 BBY]], was one of the earliest rebel victories in the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Therefore, the Galactic Civil War must have begun by 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> As the Rebellion grew in power, some Imperial tacticians such as Thrawn<ref name="Steps Into Shadow" /> and [[ISB Supervisor]] Commander [[Dedra Meero]]<ref name="Announcement">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> realized the Empire was facing a galaxy-wide insurgency.<ref name="Steps Into Shadow" />

In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> the rebel cells [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance|officially]] formed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] under [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]]<ref name="Secret Cargo">{{Rebels|Secret Cargo}}</ref> and [[Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]].<ref name="Rebel DB" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> in an attempt to obtain the [[Death Star plans]], the Rebel Alliance launched an [[Battle of Scarif|attack]] on Scarif,<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> which marked the first victory for the Rebellion in the Galactic Civil War. Shortly later,<ref name="Episode IV" /> in 1 BBY,<ref name="Atlas Updated">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> the Empire [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]] the planet Alderaan under Emperor Palpatine’s protege Governor [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] to showcase the power of the Death Star. In response, the Rebel Alliance used the stolen Death Star plans to destroy the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

[[File:X-wings-and-DS2.png|thumb|left|250px|With the Emperor slain and the second Death Star destroyed, the Battle of Endor marked a turning point in the Galactic Civil War.]]
For the next four years, the galaxy was locked in a civil war between the Empire and the Rebel Alliance. Fighting took place at locations like the Mid Rim, Sullust,<ref name="Twilight Company" /> [[Hoth]], and [[Cloud City]].<ref name="Episode V" /> Crimson Dawn would also re-emerge and launch a [[war against the Sith]], which would end in its defeat at the hands of Sidious and Vader.<ref name="Hidden Empire 5">[[Hidden Empire 5|''Hidden Empire'' 5]]</ref> In the wake of Crimson Dawn's defeat, a rogue droid known as the [[Scourge]] emerged and spread an [[Scourge crisis|infection of droids and cyborgs]]<ref name="Dark Droids 1">[[Dark Droids 1|''Dark Droids'' 1]]</ref> with the ultimate goal of taking over the Force, only to be opposed by the [[warrior-priest droid]] [[Ajax Sigma]].<ref name="Dark Droids Target Vader">{{Marvel|url=articles/comics/star-wars-dark-droids-checklist-reading-order-scourge|text=The Scourge Reveals Its Ultimate Goal by Targeting Darth Vader in 'Star Wars: Dark Droids'}}</ref> In secret, the Emperor commissioned the construction of a [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] above Endor and [[Battle of Endor|laid a trap]] for the Rebel Alliance in a calculated gamble. However, Vader’s son Jedi Knight [[Luke Skywalker]] managed to redeem him before he saved his son by fulfilling his destiny of killing Emperor Palpatine, destroying the Sith again,<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> and bringing balance back to the Force.<ref name="Luke Bio Gallery">{{Databank|luke-skywalker-biography-gallery|Luke Skywalker Biography Gallery}}</ref> The death of Emperor Palpatine and the destruction of the Death Star II had a cataclysmic effect on the galaxy.<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref>

===The New Republic===
{{Main|New Republic Era}}
{{Quote|Join us in the foundation of a new Republic<!--decapitalization of "new" is intentional, since the game's captions format it that way--> to be shaped by the will of the governed. Claim your freedom and your future. Help is on the way.|Leia Organa|<ref name="Uprising" />}}
[[File:A_New_Dawn-SWP.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The founding of the New Republic marked the dawn of a new era in galactic history.]]
Following the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance transitioned into the [[New Republic]]. The Galactic Civil War reached a new crescendo as the New Republic made numerous advances on multiple fronts against the bewildered remnants of the Empire.<ref name="Aftermath" /> The Alliance and subsequent New Republic foiled [[Operation: Cinder]], a posthumous contingency plan by the Emperor to devastate Naboo and at least a dozen other worlds.<ref name="Shattered Empire 3">[[Shattered Empire 3|''Shattered Empire'' 3]]</ref><ref name="Shattered Empire 4">[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]]</ref> In the [[Standard month|months]] after the events at Endor, New Republic and Imperial forces clashed on numerous fronts including the [[Anoat sector]],<ref name="Uprising" /> Malastare, Geonosis, [[Naalol]], [[Sevarcos]], and [[Akiva]].<ref name="Aftermath" /> A [[Coruscant civil war|civil war]] also broke out on the galactic capital of Coruscant.<ref name="Life Debt" />

By [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Life Debt date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> the New Republic had reconstituted the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] on [[Chandrila]] and gained control of the HoloNet and large swaths of the galaxy, including Akiva and Kuat. Solo, Chewbacca, and a team of Wookiee [[Exile (punishment)|exiles]] and other allies also [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|liberated]] Kashyyyk from Imperial rule. However, the chaos caused by the Civil War and the death of [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] which occurred before Palpatine’s death allowed various criminal factions including the [[pirate]] lord [[Eleodie Maracavanya]] and the [[Red Key Raiders]] to gain traction. A string of Imperial defeats led Grand Admiral [[Rae Sloane]] to propose [[Imperial–Republic peace talks|peace talks]] with [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] Mon Mothma. However, the [[Attack on Chandrila|attack]] on Chandrila destroyed the mood for diplomacy and enabled [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Gallius Rax]] to seize power.<ref name="Life Debt" />

[[File:Graveyard_of_the_Empire.png|thumb|left|250px|In the aftermath of the Battle of Jakku, the Galactic Empire formally capitulated to the New Republic.]]
Proclaiming himself [[Counselor to the Empire]], Rax brought most of the Imperial remnants to the desert world of [[Jakku]] for a [[Battle of Jakku|showdown]] with the New Republic. In truth, Rax planned to execute the final stage of Emperor Palpatine's [[Contingency]] which involved exploding the planet Jakku in order to destroy what remained of the Empire. Rax planned to lead a worthy [[Unknown Regions Imperial remnant|remnant]] into the Unknown Regions to build a new order. Several months later, New Republic agents discovered Rax's forces and the Senate dispatched a fleet to Jakku. Amidst the fighting, Sloane joined forces with New Republic Agents [[Norra Wexley|Norra]] and her son [[Brentin Lore Wexley]] to foil Rax's plan. Meanwhile, Mas Amedda escaped house arrest and signed the [[Galactic Concordance]] with Chancellor Mothma, facilitating the Empire's [[Imperial Instruments of Surrender|surrender]] to the New Republic. While the New Republic celebrated its victory, Sloane and other loyal Imperial forces fled into the Unknown Regions.<ref name="Empire's End" />

[[File:HuxAndStormtroopersAtCommandCenter-TFAOfficialTeaser.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Formed from a secret Imperial Contingency, the First Order of the Unknown Regions challenged the New Republic's place in the galaxy.]]
Following the Battle of Jakku, the defeated remnants of the Empire signed the Galactic Concordance, which imposed harsh war reparations and demilitarized the galaxy. With the Empire defeated, the New Republic turned its attention to reshaping the galactic order. Under New Republic rule, the galaxy endured peace for the next twenty-nine years. A group of Imperial hardliners eventually left Imperial space and rebuilt themselves upon joining the [[First Order]], a military junta founded by former Imperials in the Unknown Regions secretly dedicated to overthrowing the Republic. In the veil of the Unknown Regions, the First Order rearmed their [[First Order military|military forces]] and built [[Starkiller Base]] in anticipation for their war to retake the galaxy, though this was all in direct violation of the Galactic Concordance.<ref name="TFA VD" />

By [[28 ABY]],<ref name="Bloodline date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Bloodline'' to [[28 ABY]]</ref> the New Republic had become weakened by infighting between two powerful factions: the [[Populists]], who sought greater autonomy, and the [[Centrists]], who desired a stronger central government. The New Republic's inability to enforce financial regulations and patrol the galactic shipping lanes allowed criminal factions such as [[Rinnrivin Di]]'s [[Rinnrivin Di's cartel|cartel]] and the [[Amaxine warriors (New Republic Era)|Amaxine warriors]] to [[Napkin Bombing|emerge]]. In secret, these were front organizations that had been created by the First Order to generate revenue for its rearmament program and to subvert the New Republic. With the New Republic leadership unwilling to take action against the threat of the First Order to its existence, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] founded a paramilitary outfit called the [[Resistance]].<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref>

===First Order-Resistance War===
====Rise of the First Order====
{{Main|First Order-Resistance War}}
{{Quote|Today is the end of the Republic! The end of a regime that acquiesces to disorder! At this very moment, in a system far from here the New Republic lies to the galaxy while secretly supporting the treachery of the loathsome Resistance. This fierce machine which you have built, upon which we stand, will bring an end to the Senate! To their cherished fleet! All remaining systems will bow to the First Order! And will remember this as the last day of the Republic!|Armitage Hux|<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>}}
[[File:Hux_and_Starkiller_Base.png|thumb|left|250px|The completion of Starkiller Base provided the First Order with the power of destroying the New Republic in a single preemptive attack.]]
During the Cold War, the [[Borderlands]] had become a buffer zone between the New Republic and the expanding First Order. Unwilling to risk conflict with the Order, the Republic ordered its military to avoid hostilities with any of it forces.<ref name="BTA">''[[Before the Awakening]]''</ref> After failing to stop Resistance [[droid]] [[BB-8]], [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]], Solo and Chewbacca from escaping with a [[Map to Skywalker|map]] leading to Luke, the last Jedi, who had gone into self-exile after his [[Destruction of the Jedi Temple|efforts to restore the Jedi Order were destroyed]], the First Order used their superweapon on Starkiller Base to launch a preemptive attack on the New Republic’s current capital Hosnian Prime<ref name="Episode VII" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Timelines" /> Marking the start of the [[Starkiller crisis]], the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]] was witnessed across the galaxy since the First Order had discovered a way of firing [[dark energy]] through [[sub-hyperspace]] within [[Standard minute|minutes]].<ref name="TFA novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' novelization]]</ref> In response, the Resistance [[Battle of Starkiller Base|destroyed]] Starkiller Base.<ref name="Episode VII" />

Prior to the outbreak of the First Order-Resistance War, Resistance [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] was posted to the ''[[Colossus]]'', a [[supertanker fuel depot]] based on the Mid Rim planet [[Castilon]].<ref name="The Recruit">{{Resistance|The Recruit}}</ref> The ''Colossus'' was subsequently [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupied]] by the First Order,<ref name="TFOO">{{Resistance|The First Order Occupation}}</ref> which wanted to exploit the station as a military supply line.<ref name="The New Trooper">{{Resistance|The New Trooper}}</ref> Following the Hosnian Cataclysm, Xiono and rebel veteran Commander [[Jarek Yeager]] led an [[Battle of Castilon|uprising]] and brought the ''Colossus'' into space.<ref name="No Escape Part 2">{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}}</ref> In response, the First Order launched a [[Hunt for the Colossus|hunt]] for the ''Colossus'', seeking to destroy it.<ref name="Into the Unknown">{{Resistance|Into the Unknown}}</ref>

[[File:DarkOrder.png|thumb|right|250px|Kylo Ren, the grandson of Darth Vader, usurped Snoke's place as the Supreme Leader of the First Order.]]
Despite the destruction of Starkiller Base, the Hosnian Cataclysm decapitated the New Republic. As a result, [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]] deployed his [[legion]]s to seize military control over the galaxy. Rey predicted the major systems would fall to the First Order within weeks. The First Order also launched an offensive against the Resistance, [[Battle of D'Qar|destroying]] their base on D'Qar and [[Battle of Oetchi|pursuing]] them through space with a [[hyperspace tracker]]. Though the First Order inflicted heavy casualties on the Resistance, the First Order sustained serious losses when [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] [[Holdo maneuver|rammed]] the Resistance's flagship the [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] into Supreme Leader Snoke's flagship the ''[[Supremacy]]'' while he was assassinated by his apprentice and Anakin’s grandson [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], who claimed the title of Supreme Leader. Ren pursued the surviving members of the Resistance to the planet [[Crait]]. There, Luke made his [[Battle of Crait|last stand]] which gave the Resistance and Rey enough time to escape aboard the ''Millennium Falcon''.<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

====Rise of the galaxy====
{{Main|Uprising against the First Order}}
{{Quote|People are rising up all over the galaxy. Poe, we did it.''"<br />"''We did it.|Finn and Poe Dameron|<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>|audio=PeopleAreRising-TheRiseOfSkywalker.flac}}
[[File:Xyston-engines.png|thumb|left|250px|The Final Order was a Sith fleet constructed by the followers of Emperor Palpatine, who was resurrected on Exegol.]]
Although Emperor Palpatine's body was destroyed during the Battle of Endor, he [[Transference|transferred]] his spirit into a clone after the fall of the Empire, however the process that created it was unfinished, forcing him to inhabit an unstable vessel and survived for another generation while his followers, a [[Sith cult]] known as the [[Sith Eternal]], created the [[Final Order]]—a massive armada of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]] capable of destroying planets.<ref name="SOTS" />

With the galaxy at war again and the Final Order complete, Palpatine came out of hiding and announced his return<ref name="TSWB" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="IX Date">{{FilmDate|IX}}</ref> In his [[Exegol Broadcast|Broadcast]] he demanded the submission of every world in the galaxy and revealed his true identity as a Sith Lord, which he no longer treated to be secret. The inhabitants of the galaxy were sent into a state of disbelief and fright when they learnt of Emperor Palpatine's survival.<ref name="TSWB" /> Kylo Ren, having vowed never to serve another master and believing in letting go of the past,<ref name="TROS VD" /> regarded Palpatine as an intolerable threat to his power as Supreme Leader.<ref name="Episode IX" /> As a result, Ren's priorities shifted from defeating the Resistance and suppressing their galaxy wide rebellion against his rule,<ref name="TROS VD" /> to finding the Sith Lord so he could finish what his grandfather started and destroy the Sith once more.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:SidiousandKyloRen-TROS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ren tracked Palpatine to Exegol, where he discovered the Sith fleet as well as the secret of Rey's lineage.]]
Using his grandfather’s [[Vader's wayfinder|wayfinder]] acquired on [[Mustafar]], Ren journeyed to Exegol where he discovered Emperor Palpatine along with the Sith Eternal and the Final Order. He revealed his role behind the creation of Snoke and turning Ren to the dark side; he then offered the Sith fleet and title of Emperor to Ren if he killed Rey, the last Jedi before being warned that she was, in fact, his granddaughter.<ref name="Episode IX" />

With the help of the embittered General [[Armitage Hux]], the Resistance discovered Palpatine returned with a immense armada to attack the free worlds in sixteen hours and reinforce the First Order so he can rule the galaxy again and resurrect the Empire from its ashes to complete the final stages of the contingency of his master plan to achieve the Revenge of the Sith. Rey, Finn, Dameron, Chewbacca, BB-8, and C-3PO embarked on a mission to recover Palpatine’s [[Emperor's wayfinder|wayfinder]] to reach Exegol. Following a series of adventures with the First Order and [[Knights of Ren]], Rey acquired a wayfinder and [[Mission to Kef Bir|fought]] with Ren on [[Kef Bir]], in the process discovering her true [[Palpatine family|lineage]] as Sidious' granddaughter. After sensing the death of his mother, and conversing with the spirit of his father, Ren returned to the [[Light side of the Force|light side]] and reclaimed his identity as Ben.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:KijimiGoBoom-TROS.png|thumb|left|250px|The planet Kijimi was destroyed as a demonstration of the Sith Eternal's power.]]
Having sworn fealty to Palpatine once more like he did during the dark times of the Empire after Ben's renunciation of the dark side, [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] deployed the ''[[Derriphan]]''—one of the Star Destroyers from Exegol—to [[Kijimi]]. The ''Derriphan'' used its [[axial superlaser]] to [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroy]] Kijimi, demonstrating the power of a single Star Destroyer of the Final Order after Pryde activated [[Protocol 13]]. Under the leadership of General Dameron and General Finn, the Resistance launched an attack on Exegol, attempting to prevent the Sith fleet's attack on the free worlds and union with the First Order.<ref name="Episode IX" />

Though initially outnumbered by the Sith Eternal's [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]], the Resistance was reinforced by the [[Citizens' Fleet]] led by General Calrissian. Meanwhile, Rey and Solo joined forces to defeat the Sith Lord for good at his [[Sith Citadel]] beneath Exegol. Realizing the two shared a [[Force-bond|bond]] as a [[Force dyad]], Palpatine drained their life energy and attacked the Resistance with [[Force lightning]]. Rey was able to defeat Emperor Palpatine for good with the help of her Jedi predecessors, thereby preventing the return of the Sith. Despite succumbing to her injuries, Rey was resurrected by Solo, who [[Force healing|transferred]] his life force to her at the cost of his life.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:BattleofExegolcontinues-RiseIDW.png|thumb|right|250px|The Citizens' Fleet joined the Resistance to defeat the Sith Eternal's forces during the Battle of Exegol.]]
The defeat of Palpatine and the Sith Eternal precipitated a galactic uprising against the First Order. As a result, the First Order's forces were beset by insurrection on various worlds, from [[Uprising on Cloud City|Bespin]], [[Uprising on Endor|Endor]], and [[Uprising on Jakku|Jakku]],<ref name="Episode IX" /> to [[Uprising on Naboo (First Order)|Naboo]], [[Uprising on Corellia|Corellia]], and [[Uprising on Coruscant|Coruscant]].<ref name="TROS JN">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> The Resistance and the galaxy celebrated their victory<ref name="Episode IX" /> and the defeat of the First Order.<ref name="TSWB" /> In the wake of the conflict, the people of the galaxy began the long process of rebuilding their home after the destruction brought about by the First Order-Resistance War. Resistance historian Captain [[Beaumont Kin]] was given the task of overseeing an excavation of the Sith Citadel and wrote and published his new book ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' to educate the people about the Imperial regime. Rey, meanwhile, claimed the Skywalker name, became a Jedi Master like Luke did, and started to rebuild the Jedi Order to maintain peace and justice in the galaxy and balance in the Force.<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TheGalaxy-GEG.png|thumb|left|250px|A slightly inaccurate map featuring several major regions as printed in ''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'']]
The galaxy first appeared in the [[1977]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Episode IV" /> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the galaxy was said to have 3.2 billion habitable systems.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> However, the [[Canon]] books ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' and ''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' stated that the galaxy only had 3.2 million.<ref name="VE" /><ref name="TSWB" /> This statistic was later corrected in later reprintings of ''Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia''.<ref name="VE" />

The 2025 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' utilized the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] system in its map of the galaxy, directly copying the old system used in the 2009 legends reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. Both books labeled each grid as being 5,000 light-years in diameter with 21 grids vertically and 23 grids horizontally overlaid on a map of the galaxy, meaning the galaxy is approximately 105,000 light-years on the y-axis and 115,000 light-years on the x-axis.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref><ref name="EA" />
